title: OpenAI details influence operations built behind convincing false fronts
friendlyTitle: AI helped fake organisations look more believable
summary: OpenAI says it banned Russian- and Iranian-linked influence operations that used its models alongside older tactics to run a purported think tank and fake journalist personas. Unlike many low-reach social campaigns, parts of these operations placed material in established external publications.
friendlySummary: OpenAI found groups using ChatGPT to support fake journalists and a false research organisation. Some of their material reached real media outlets.
whyItMatters: AI can make deceptive outreach more fluent and scalable, while a credible organisation or contributor biography can provide the trust needed for distribution. Editors, businesses and individuals should verify who is behind unsolicited expert content rather than treating polished writing as evidence of authenticity.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Well-written messages and professional profiles can still be fake. Check the person and organisation before publishing or acting on unexpected content.
